summary: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Headquarters warns of planned U.S. military action against Iran coordinated with regional states after a European meeting. A suicide drone targeted Erbil International Airport in Iraq's Kurdistan region, with air defenses reportedly intercepting it. Israeli forces captured the perpetrator of a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf in the West Bank and plan a brigade-level operation in the attacker's home village of Bidu.
key_points: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters claims intelligence shows U.S. plans to resume actions against Iran with regional countries' 'green light' after a joint meeting in a European country. (Source: @VahidOnline/78458)
A suicide drone targeted Erbil International Airport in Iraq; Iraqi security sources say air defense intercepted it near the airport. (Source: @VahidOnline/78460)
Israeli Duvdevan commandos captured the terrorist who carried out the shooting attack at Ein Riyah spring near Neve Tzuf in the Benjamin region. (Source: @amitsegal/65030)

IDF plans a brigade-level operation in Bidu village, the attacker's origin, including arrests and home demolition preparation; 27 battalions deploying across West Bank and Jordan Valley for Yom Kippur. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393466)
Saudi-led coalition says it thwarted Houthi attacks targeting civilians in Saudi cities Bisha, Taif, Farasan, and Yanbu. (Source: @New_security8200/203862)
Saudi warplanes struck communication towers in Sa'ada and Al-Jawf governorates in northern Yemen. (Source: @SharghDaily/184766)
Iranian Army Ground Forces Commander Brig. Gen. Jahanshahi states border units remain deployed and on constant alert in various border areas. (Source: @presstv/207549)
U.S. State Department warns Americans to reconsider travel to the Middle East due to potential for unexpected escalation, flight cancellations, and airspace closures. (Source: @mamlekate/104559)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Headquarters warns of planned U.S. military action against Iran coordinated with regional states after a European meeting. A suicide drone targeted Erbil International Airport in Iraq's Kurdistan region, with air defenses reportedly intercepting it. Israeli forces captured the perpetrator of a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf in the West Bank and plan a brigade-level operation in the attacker's home village of Bidu.

points: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters issued a statement claiming receipt of intelligence that the United States has decided to resume actions against Iran with the 'green light' of some regional countries following a joint meeting in a European country, though no participants or host country were named. (Source: @VahidOnline/78458)

The headquarters warned regional countries that if they align with a U.S. attack, 'all will be considered partners in this mischief' and cannot expect 'goodwill or chivalry from Iran's powerful armed forces.' (Source: @VahidOnline/78458)

Khatam al-Anbiya threatened that in case of an attack, 'all centers and interests of that country in the region, without any limitation or consideration, will become targets of sustained, effective, and painful strikes.' (Source: @VahidOnline/78458)

Iranian Army Ground Forces Commander Brigadier General Jahanshahi stated that Army border units remain deployed and on constant alert in various border areas, prepared to counter any potential threats and protect the country's security and territorial integrity. (Source: @presstv/207549)

Iranian police in Khuzestan province seized 152 illegal weapons — including 59 military firearms and 94 hunting rifles — along with 2,916 rounds of ammunition, and arrested 89 suspects in coordinated operations. (Source: @SharghDaily/184767)

An explosion was reported on Kish Island at 11:05 AM local time, heard across the island; local sources claim officials attempted to attribute it to unexploded ordnance disposal but the explosion preceded official reports. (Source: @mamlekate/104564)

A Palestinian gunman opened fire on a civilian vehicle at Ein Riyah spring near Neve Tzuf in the Benjamin region; an Israeli soldier in an armored vehicle returned fire and the attacker fled on foot, prompting a large-scale manhunt. (Source: @pkpoi/144017)

IDF and Shin Bet forces arrested two suspects who admitted to arson near Burqa village in the Shomron Brigade area; the suspects were transferred for further investigation. (Source: @New_security8200/203859)

Israeli Duvdevan commandos captured the Neve Tzuf attacker at a hospital in Ramallah; he is the first potential subject of the death penalty law passed in the current Knesset at Ben-Gvir's demand. (Source: @amitsegal/65030, @amitsegal/65031)

IDF Chief of Staff held a situation assessment with Central Command chief following the attack; 27 battalions including Egoz and Duvdevan commando units will deploy across the West Bank and Jordan Valley for Yom Kippur. (Source: @pkpoi/144024, @rasedal3ado138e/393466)

A brigade-level operation is planned for Bidu village, the attacker's home, starting tonight, including suspect arrests and mapping the attacker's home for demolition; widespread arrest campaigns across the West Bank expected to detain dozens. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393466)
UAE officially denied reports that Mohamed bin Zayed spoke with Netanyahu, stating the report is false. (Source: @amitsegal/65014)

Shooting attack at Ein Riyah spring near Neve Tzuf settlement in Benjamin region: gunman fired on civilian in vehicle, soldier in armored vehicle engaged, attacker fled on foot; manhunt launched with roadblocks. (Source: @pkpoi/144017, @idf_telegram/25162)
Attacker captured by Duvdevan unit at a hospital in Ramallah; identified as first potential case for newly enacted death penalty law. (Source: @amitsegal/65030, @amitsegal/65031)

IDF plans brigade-level operation in Bidu village (attacker's origin) including arrests and home demolition preparation; 27 battalions deploying across West Bank and Jordan Valley for Yom Kippur including Egoz and Duvdevan units. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393466)
Two arson suspects arrested near Burqa village in Shomron Brigade area after igniting fire; both confessed and transferred for investigation. (Source: @New_security8200/203859)
Widespread arrest campaigns expected across West Bank with dozens of detentions anticipated. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393466)

Daily artillery shelling report for September 20, 2026 lists 19 shelling incidents across southern Lebanon including Kfar Tibnit, Zibqin, Kfar Shouba, Wadi al-Hujeir, Aita al-Jabal, Barashit, Bint Jbeil, Wadi al-Saluqi, Beit Yahoun, Hadatha, Yater, Kounine, Al-Mansouri, Zibqin al-Sharqiya, Al-Khiam, Beit Lif. (Source: @redlinkleb/43941)
Updated map shows areas affected by hostile drone activity in southern Lebanon skies; red circles indicate number of affected areas, not number of drones. (Source: @redlinkleb/43972)

Suicide drone targeted Erbil International Airport in Iraq's Kurdistan region; Reuters citing Iraqi security sources reports air defense intercepted and downed the drone near the airport at approximately 17:30 on September 29 (Shahrivar 29). (Source: @VahidOnline/78460)

Multiple explosions heard in Erbil area moments before the drone interception; smoke columns observed rising from Erbil province after the blast. (Source: @SharghDaily/184772, @naya_foriraq/91074, @naya_foriraq/91075)
Arab sources report Erbil airport was targeted by a suicide drone; additional explosions heard in the area. (Source: @SharghDaily/184772)
Saudi-led coalition announced it thwarted Houthi attacks targeting civilians in Saudi cities Bisha, Taif, Farasan, and Yanbu. (Source: @New_security8200/203862)

Saudi warplanes struck communication towers in Salba and Rahab areas in Annan district, one tower in Al-Mara'shi, and another in Al-Zahir in Al-Jawf governorate, northern Yemen. (Source: @SharghDaily/184766)
Houthi General Al-Zubaydi claimed UAE asked Houthis to bomb Saudi Arabia's NEOM project in exchange for formal recognition of the Houthis. (Source: @kianmeli1/92303)
Report states U.S. is in constant communication with Houthis who have agreed not to fight the United States, per Trey Yingst on Fox News citing President Trump. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7309)
UAE officially denied reports that Mohamed bin Zayed spoke with Israeli PM Netanyahu, calling the report false. (Source: @amitsegal/65014)

key_developments: Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya HQ claims U.S. plans military action against Iran with regional backing after European meeting; threatens strikes on all U.S. bases and interests in region if attacked. (Source: @VahidOnline/78458)
Suicide drone intercepted by air defense near Erbil International Airport in Iraqi Kurdistan; multiple explosions reported, smoke visible over Erbil. (Source: @VahidOnline/78460)
Israeli Duvdevan commandos capture Neve Tzuf shooter at Ramallah hospital; attacker from Bidu village, first potential death penalty case under new law. (Source: @amitsegal/65030)

IDF preparing brigade-level operation in Bidu village including arrests and home demolition; 27 battalions deploying across West Bank and Jordan Valley for Yom Kippur. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393466)
Saudi coalition thwarts Houthi attacks on Bisha, Taif, Farasan, Yanbu; Saudi jets strike communication towers in Sa'ada and Al-Jawf, Yemen. (Source: @New_security8200/203862, @SharghDaily/184766)
U.S. State Department warns Americans to reconsider Middle East travel citing unpredictable escalation risk, flight cancellations, airspace closures. (Source: @mamlekate/104559)
Iranian Army border units on constant alert across border areas per Ground Forces Commander Brig. Gen. Jahanshahi. (Source: @presstv/207549)
sections.threat_assessment: Iran's explicit warning of retaliatory strikes against all U.S. regional bases and interests if attacked marks a significant escalation in deterrence posture, directly linking regional partners to potential targeting. The Erbil drone attack demonstrates continued militia capability to strike U.S.-linked infrastructure in Iraq despite air defenses. Israel's planned brigade-level West Bank operation with 27 battalions signals sustained high-tempo counterterrorism posture during Yom Kippur, risking broader confrontation. Saudi-Houthi kinetic exchanges persist despite reported U.S.-Houthi de-escalation channel, indicating fragmented conflict dynamics.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states show divergent responses: Saudi Arabia maintains kinetic pressure on Houthis while UAE denies coordination with Israel and Houthi claims of UAE-Houthi NEOM deal. Iran's threat to target regional countries supporting U.S. action creates pressure on Gulf states to distance from potential U.S. strikes. Iraqi Kurdistan's air defense interception at Erbil demonstrates improved point defense but persistent vulnerability to drone threats. U.S. travel warning reflects institutional concern over uncontrollable escalation pathways.
sections.intelligence_notes: Khatam al-Anbiya's specific claim of a European-hosted coordination meeting is unverified but operationally significant if true — suggests diplomatic preparation for military action. The Erbil attack timing coincides with Iranian warnings, possibly signaling militia responsiveness to Iranian strategic direction. Israel's deployment of elite commando units (Egoz, Duvdevan) for Yom Kippur West Bank security indicates expectation of heightened friction. Houthi-Saudi strikes continue despite reported U.S.-Houthi understandings, suggesting either rogue elements or strategic hedging by Ansarallah.
